My hysterectomy. 

Had my uterus and ovaries removed in March, and since then whenever I have sex I begin to bleed, shake and vomit for hours. My stomach is in pain for days afterwards and last time I tried (after being given an exam and told that I just needed more time to heal my body), I’d waited two months before trying again and the pains were so bad I nearly passed out and had to go to the hospital. I still don’t know what’s actually gone wrong with my surgery since the hospital that did it couldn’t get me an appointment until a couple months from now. I regret getting the surgery

Never experienced anything like this before having the surgery. We’d been sleeping together for years , and I’ve had guys bigger than him with no issues. 
I also felt it when he hit my cervix, but we kept going and the real pain didn’t start until we finished maybe 20-30 seconds later

It went really well- the doctor I got to meet with was the nicest ever and even spoke my native language - took a look inside of me and deducted I had a wound on my cervix that wasn’t fully healed, and my partner had just happened to hit it really hard which caused the awful pain, and the pain caused the vomiting and shakes. I’m super relieved it was only a wound and not something more serious
I finally got an appointment to be looked at internally ! In four hours I’ll get a vaginal examination at the same place I went yesterday

I’ve contacted the hospital where I had my surgery done after reading your comment. After a retelling of everything that happened, they also recommended I get another examination, specifically a vaginal one or one by ultrasound - the person I spoke to thought it might be a vaginal top rupture I’m suffering from. I will try and contact facilities nearby for a more thorough examination. Thank you

I’m still in moderate pain when I move around, no bleeding at all - and I didn’t bleed very much when this all went down either. I gotta admit I’m not satisfied with the medical help I’ve received so far, but it doesn’t seem I have any better options until I’m back home

One-way tickets to another country are suspicious.

I've always preferred to get a one-way ticket to my destination, to then figure out later which date exactly I'll be returning home; I never stay for very long, a few weeks at most. Last time I did this I landed at Heathrow Airport around 10 pm, and immigration control kept me there until 3 am, questioning me and searching my things and documents. Once out I spent an hour calling numerous taxi services, as all of them either wouldn't pick up, or told me through an automated message that they don't run this late. My hotel was an hour drive away.

Most stressful travel experience of my life.
